**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 23:17  
[EVENT] User is planning a solo trip to Sequoia National Park next month.  
[EVENT] User hiked Yosemite's Vernal Falls last month with friends Alex and Sarah.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for hiking trails in Sequoia National Park that offer scenic views similar to Yosemite's Vernal Falls.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended hiking trails in Sequoia National Park:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. High Sierra Trail to Hamilton Lakes: about 12 miles round-trip, stunning views, lush forest, crosses Kern River, picturesque Hamilton Lakes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Alta Peak Trail: about 14 miles round-trip, panoramic views from the highest peak in Sequoia National Park (11,200 ft), views of Great Western Divide, Kaweah Range, Sierra Nevada mountains.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Marble Falls Trail: about 4 miles round-trip, leads to Marble Falls, impressive sight, passes through lush forest along Crystal Cave Road.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Big Trees Trail to Moro Rock: about 2 miles round-trip, through giant sequoias, ends at Moro Rock with spectacular views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Congress Trail: about 2 miles round-trip, through giant sequoias, includes Congress Grove, breathtaking scenery, opportunity to see large trees.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should check trail conditions, difficulty levels, and any necessary permits or restrictions before heading out.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should stop by the park's visitor center for up-to-date information and advice from park rangers.  
[EVENT] User is planning to camp during the trip.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to know if they need to reserve campsites in advance, similar to Upper Pines Campground in Yosemite.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Camping reservations in Sequoia National Park work differently than in Yosemite:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Some campgrounds are first-come, first-served, while others can be reserved in advance through recreation.gov.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended to reserve a campsite in advance during peak season (June to August) as they fill up quickly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reservations can be made up to six months in advance on recreation.gov.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular campgrounds in Sequoia National Park include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Lodgepole Campground: open year-round, reservations available through recreation.gov.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Dorst Creek Campground: open mid-May
